title: 12 Best Nairobi's Specialty Coffee Scene
description: Explore Nairobi's thriving specialty coffee scene. Discover top roasters, cozy cafes, and hidden gems offering Kenya's finest beans. Your guide to the best coffee experiences in the city.

places.name: Cultiva Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their V60 pour-over with a rotating single-origin Kenyan bean.

places.name: Connect Coffee Roasters & Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cold brew, especially their Kyoto-style slow drip, paired with one of their unique Japanese-inspired pastries.

places.name: Spring Valley Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic cappuccino made with their signature house blend, accompanied by their popular avocado toast.

places.name: Pointzero Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An espresso shot or macchiato to truly appreciate the depth of their roast.

places.name: River Cafe at Karura Forest
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Americano or Latte, paired with one of their freshly baked cakes, while soaking in the forest views.

places.name: Kesh Kesh Coffee Roastery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Experience the Ethiopian Buna (coffee ceremony) if available, or a rich Ethiopian Sidamo pour-over.

places.name: Wasp & Sprout
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flat white with a side of their famous shakshuka or any of their delicious brunch items.

places.name: Artcaffe (Various Branches)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their mocha or a classic latte, paired with a freshly baked croissant or their New York cheesecake.

places.name: Java House (Various Branches)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Kenyan Dawa tea or a strong espresso if you're looking for a quick pick-me-up.

places.name: The Daily Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their cappuccino and a fresh smoothie or one of their vibrant salad bowls.

places.name: Dormans Coffee (Yaya Centre Branch)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic filter coffee, brewed with one of their medium-dark roast Kenyan blends, for a robust flavor.

places.name: About Thyme Restaurant & Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An after-meal espresso or a perfectly crafted cappuccino, perhaps with one of their delectable desserts.
